entries.00ca5450ae2cc747: A business that supports companies' digital marketing activities. It consists of the SaaS business, which centers on the in-house web analytics tool “SiTest” and performs access analysis and improvement of websites and videos; the online advertising business, which handles planning and proposals, outsourced operation and content production for internet advertising; and the education and reskilling business, which includes the reskilling program “Risunabi” and others. entries.910e1b9f47e76d78: A business that uses AI and data analysis technology. It consists of the DX Development Business, which handles proposal-based contract development and AI-related products such as the AI avatar video production product “AvaTwin,” and the SPAIA Business, which operates the sports data analysis media “SPAIA” and the subscription-based horse racing information service “SPAIA Keiba” and provides sports data. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is ¥259 million.
